provenance.author: this repository
provenance.method: exhaustion over all pairs of 3-qubit stabilizer states, via the quotient by the target

notes: Pairs with the annealed rank-3 decomposition to settle chi(|T>^3) = 3 exactly. The exclusion is numerical and rests on a margin: the closest any two key-adjacent quotient directions come to parallel is 0.81 against a threshold of 1 - 1e-6. The T-type state at m=2, whose rank-2 decomposition is verified on the board, is the positive control.
